title: Memory optimization for small-language-model-driven security agents
audience: Final review panel: internal faculty examiner and an industry examiner. Know security and software engineering, have not read this codebase.
goal: Convince the panel the work is complete, measured, honest about its limits, and technically contributed by all three students.
register: technical and exact; short declarative sentences; identifiers and tool names in mono
direction: Terminal Noir, phosphor accent #7CFF6B on near-black, Geist display and JetBrains Mono labels

motion.concept: Cinematic by default. The agent loop, the phase machine and the DEPG draw themselves and carry packets along their edges, so structure arrives as movement rather than as a static picture. The compaction cascade is a bespoke hook: three lanes of the same conversation collapsing one tier harder, which is the only way to show that compaction is a choice between tiers and not a single cut. Bars grow, the headline numbers count, and canvas fields run on the three section openers and the close only. Everything else is quiet, so the diagrams and the two numbers that matter get the attention.
